```{.r .cell-code}
# Extract params from one file (small object)
res            <- readRDS("results/Sensitivity_ColdOnly_Plegacy_05p.rds")
sim_params     <- res$params
exp_start_date <- sim_params$mindate + years(sim_params$nyears_burnin)
rm(res)

# Helper: read one scenario, extract ibm_long and spawn_log, and free res before returning
load_scen <- function(path, ptype, pc, ht, ac, aw, pcmax_cold, pcmax_warm, species) {
  res <- readRDS(path)
  list(df = res$ibm_long, spawn_log = res$spawn_log, 
       ptype = ptype, pc = pc, ht = ht, ac = ac, aw = aw, pcmax_cold = pcmax_cold, pcmax_warm = pcmax_warm, species = species)
}

ibm_list_mech <- list(
  load_scen("results/Sensitivity_ColdOnly_Plegacy_05p.rds",     "legacy",     0.50, "Cold only",    1.0,  0.0,  0.5,  NA_real_, "STHD"),
  load_scen("results/Sensitivity_ColdOnly_Pcorrected_05p.rds",  "corrected",  0.50, "Cold only",    1.0,  0.0,  0.5,  NA_real_, "STHD"),
  load_scen("results/Sensitivity_ColdOnly_Pfixedp_05p.rds",     "fixedp",     0.50, "Cold only",    1.0,  0.0,  0.5,  NA_real_, "STHD"),
  load_scen("results/Sensitivity_ColdWarm_Plegacy_05p.rds",     "legacy",     0.50, "Cold + Warm",  1.0,  1.0,  0.5,  0.5,      "STHD"),
  load_scen("results/Sensitivity_ColdWarm_Pcorrected_05p.rds",  "corrected",  0.50, "Cold + Warm",  1.0,  1.0,  0.5,  0.5,      "STHD"),
  load_scen("results/Sensitivity_ColdWarm_Pfixedp_05p.rds",     "fixedp",     0.50, "Cold + Warm",  1.0,  1.0,  0.5,  0.5,      "STHD")
```

Data prep

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ptype_levels   <- c("legacy", "corrected", "fixedp")
hab_levels     <- c("Cold only", "Cold + Warm")
# species_levels <- c("STHD", "CUTT")
hab_fills      <- c("Cold only" = "#6BAED6", "Cold + Warm" = "#FC8D59")

# Annotate ptype (elements 1–3 = Cold only, 4–6 = Cold + Warm; order: legacy, corrected, fixedp)
ptype_order <- c("legacy", "corrected", "fixedp")
# for (i in seq_along(ibm_list_mech)) {
#   ibm_list_mech[[i]]$ptype <- ptype_order[((i - 1) %% 3) + 1]
# }

# Oct 1 census: experimental period, survivors only
exp_oct1_mech <- purrr::map_dfr(ibm_list_mech, function(s) {
  s$df |>
    filter(date >= exp_start_date,
           month(date) == 10, day(date) == 1,
           survived == 1) |>
    mutate(ptype = s$ptype, hab_type = s$ht, #species = s$species,
           year = year(date), age_class = floor(age))
}) |>
  mutate(ptype    = factor(ptype,    levels = ptype_levels),
         hab_type = factor(hab_type, levels = hab_levels)
         #species  = factor(species,  levels = species_levels)
         )

pop_yr <- exp_oct1_mech |>
  group_by(ptype, hab_type, year) |>
  summarise(n = n(), biomass_kg = sum(weight) / 1000, .groups = "drop")

pop_sum <- pop_yr |>
  group_by(ptype, hab_type) |>
  summarise(mean_n = mean(n), sd_n = sd(n),
            mean_b = mean(biomass_kg), sd_b = sd(biomass_kg), .groups = "drop")

age0_sum <- exp_oct1_mech |>
  filter(age_class == 0) |>
  group_by(ptype, hab_type, year) |>
  summarise(n_age0 = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(ptype, hab_type) |>
  summarise(mean_n0 = mean(n_age0), sd_n0 = sd(n_age0), .groups = "drop")

waa <- exp_oct1_mech |>
  filter(age_class >= 0, age_class <= 15) |>
  group_by(ptype, hab_type, age_class) |>
  summarise(mean_wt = mean(weight), sd_wt = sd(weight), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n >= 10)

spawn_yr <- purrr::map_dfr(ibm_list_mech, function(s) {
  s$spawn_log |>
    mutate(date = sim_params$mindate + (dayofsim - 1L), yr = year(date)) |>
    filter(date >= exp_start_date) |>
    group_by(yr, parent_pid) |>
    summarize(parent_wt = mean(weight), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(yr) |>
    summarise(n_spawners = n_distinct(parent_pid), 
              biom_spawn_kg = sum(parent_wt)/1000, 
              .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(ptype = s$ptype, hab_type = s$ht)
}) |>
  mutate(ptype    = factor(ptype,    levels = ptype_levels),
         hab_type = factor(hab_type, levels = hab_levels))

spawn_yr_sum <- spawn_yr %>%
  group_by(ptype, hab_type) |>
  summarise(mean_spawners = mean(n_spawners, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_spawners   = sd(n_spawners,   na.rm = TRUE), 
            mean_spawn_biom = mean(biom_spawn_kg, na.rm = TRUE), 
            sd_spawn_biom = sd(biom_spawn_kg, na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop")

spawn_part_sum <- spawn_yr |>
  left_join(pop_yr |> select(ptype, hab_type, year, n),
            by = c("ptype", "hab_type", "yr" = "year")) |>
  mutate(prop_spawn = n_spawners / n) |>
  group_by(ptype, hab_type) |>
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop_spawn, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_prop   = sd(prop_spawn,   na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

Calculate *seasonal* warm contribution

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
patch_seasonal_mech <- purrr::map_dfr(
  ibm_list_mech[sapply(ibm_list_mech, \(s) s$ht == "Cold + Warm")],
  function(s) {
    s$df |>
      filter(date >= exp_start_date, !is.na(ggd)) |>
      mutate(
        daily_growth_g = weight * ggd,
        year   = year(date),
        season = factor(case_when(
          month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2)  ~ "Winter",
          month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5)   ~ "Spring",
          month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8)   ~ "Summer",
          month(date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
        ), levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall"))
      ) |>
      group_by(year, season, patch) |>
      summarise(total_g = sum(daily_growth_g, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
      mutate(ptype = s$ptype)
  }
) |> mutate(ptype   = factor(ptype,   levels = ptype_levels))

annual_total_mech <- patch_seasonal_mech |>
  mutate(pos_g = pmax(total_g, 0)) |>
  group_by(ptype, year) |>
  summarise(annual_pos_g = sum(pos_g, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

warm_season_sum <- patch_seasonal_mech |>
  filter(patch == "warm") |>
  mutate(pos_g = pmax(total_g, 0)) |>
  left_join(annual_total_mech, by = c("ptype", "year")) |>
  mutate(f_warm = if_else(annual_pos_g > 0, pos_g / annual_pos_g, NA_real_)) |>
  group_by(ptype, season) |>
  summarise(mean_f = mean(f_warm, na.rm = TRUE), sd_f = sd(f_warm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

```{.r .cell-code}
# ── Shared helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.75)
ptype_greens <- c(legacy = "#74C476", corrected = "#238B45", fixedp = "#00441B")


bar_plot <- function(data, y_var, y_sd, y_lab, pct = FALSE) {
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = ptype, y = .data[[y_var]], fill = hab_type)) +
    geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.65) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = pmax(0, .data[[y_var]] - .data[[y_sd]]),
          ymax = .data[[y_var]] + .data[[y_sd]]),
      position = dodge, width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = hab_fills, name = "Habitat") +
    labs(x = "Consumption type", y = y_lab) +
    # facet_wrap(~species) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "black"))
  if (pct) {
    p + scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
                           expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08)))
  } else {
    p + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08)))
  }
}
```

## Mechanisms

### Daily patch occupancy


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# For each Cold+Warm scenario, compute daily proportion of adults in warm patch,
# aligned to biological year (May 1 = day 1, April 30 = day 365), averaged over years.
may1_doy <- yday(as.Date("2001-05-01"))

occ_mean <- purrr::map_dfr(
  ibm_list_mech[sapply(ibm_list_mech, \(s) s$ht == "Cold + Warm")],
  function(s) {
    s$df |>
      filter(date >= exp_start_date, survived == 1, floor(age) >= 1) |>
      mutate(
        year    = year(date),
        bio_doy = ((yday(date) - may1_doy) %% 365L) + 1L
      ) |>
      group_by(year, bio_doy) |>
      summarise(prop_warm = mean(patch == "warm"), .groups = "drop") |>
      group_by(bio_doy) |>
      summarise(
        mean_prop_warm = mean(prop_warm),
        sd_prop_warm   = sd(prop_warm),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      mutate(ptype = s$ptype)
  }
) |>
  mutate(
    ptype    = factor(ptype,   levels = ptype_levels),
    bio_date = as.Date("2001-05-01") + bio_doy - 1L
  )

ggplot(occ_mean, aes(x = bio_date, y = mean_prop_warm, color = ptype, fill = ptype)) +
```

### Bioenergetics P by temperature


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Theoretical p_bioe curves over temperature range (dd = 1, isolates temperature effect)
# Formula by p_calc type (from SimulationLoop.R):
#   legacy:    min(fT, pcmax)
#   corrected: min(fT, pcmax) / fT
#   fixed_p:   pcmax
p_bioe_curves <- expand_grid(
  temp    = seq(0, 25, by = 0.1),
  ptype   = factor(ptype_levels,   levels = ptype_levels)
) |>
  mutate(
    pcmax          = 0.5,
    fT             = fncTempDepend(temp),
    pcmax_adjusted = pmin(fT, pcmax),
    p_bioe = case_when(
      ptype == "legacy"    ~ pcmax_adjusted,
      ptype == "corrected" ~ pcmax_adjusted / pmax(fT, 1e-6),
      ptype == "fixedp"    ~ pcmax
    )
  )

# Reconstruct empirical p_bioe from sampled simulation days.
# p_bioe (= pcmax_adjusted_dd) is not stored in ibm_long, so we recompute it:
#   1. Sample days from the experimental period.
#   2. For each day × patch × age-class group, compute dominance-weighted effective
#      density via fncEffDensity(), then dd_factor = K / (K + eff_density).
#   3. Apply the p_calc formula to get per-fish p_bioe.
#   4. Summarise to daily patch means for plotting.
#
# Parameters matching the Cold+Warm STHD/CUTT scenarios:
A_patch        <- 1.0   # habitat area (A_cold = A_warm = 1)
K_patch        <- 400   # hyperbolic half-saturation constant (K_cold = K_warm = 400)
dominance_beta <- 1     # dominance exponent

set.seed(5317)
n_sample_days <- 50

p_bioe_empirical <- purrr::map_dfr(
  ibm_list_mech[sapply(ibm_list_mech, \(s) s$ht == "Cold + Warm")],
  function(s) {
    pcmax_val   <- 0.5
    ptype_val   <- s$ptype

    df           <- s$df |> filter(date >= exp_start_date, !is.na(ggd))
    sampled_days <- sample(unique(df$dayofsim), n_sample_days)

    df |>
      filter(dayofsim %in% sampled_days) |>
      # mutate(age_class = if_else(floor(age) == 0, "age0", "age1plus")) |>
      filter(floor(age) >= 1) |>
      group_by(dayofsim, patch) |>
      mutate(
        eff_density    = (fncEffDensity(weight, beta = dominance_beta) - 1) / A_patch,
        dd_factor      = K_patch / (K_patch + eff_density),
        fT             = fncTempDepend(temp),
        pcmax_adjusted = pmin(fT, pcmax_val),
        p_bioe = case_when(
          ptype_val == "legacy"    ~ pcmax_adjusted * dd_factor,
          ptype_val == "corrected" ~ pcmax_adjusted * dd_factor / pmax(fT, 1e-6),
          ptype_val == "fixedp"    ~ pcmax_val * dd_factor
        )
      ) |>
      # Collapse to daily patch mean (temp is identical across fish within a patch-day)
      # group_by(dayofsim, patch) |>
      # summarise(temp = first(temp), mean_p_bioe = mean(p_bioe), .groups = "drop") |>
      mutate(
        ptype       = factor(ptype_val,   levels = ptype_levels),
        patch_label = factor(if_else(patch == "cold", "Cold patch", "Warm patch"),
                             levels = c("Cold patch", "Warm patch"))
      )
  }
)


### PLOT
patchtypecols <- c("Cold patch" = "blue", "Warm patch" = "red")
ggplot(p_bioe_curves, aes(x = temp, y = p_bioe)) +
  # geom_rect(data = patch_ranges,
  #           aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, fill = patch),
  #           ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = p_bioe_empirical, aes(x = temp, y = p_bioe, color = patch_label), alpha = 0.35, size = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = patchtypecols, name = "") +
  # scale_fill_manual(
  #   values = ,
  # name = "Patch (5\u201395th %ile)"
  # ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 25, by = 5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
facet_wrap(~ ptype, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x        = "Temperature (\u00b0C)",
    y        = "p_bioe",
    title    = "Bioenergetics P by temperature and consumption type",
    subtitle = "Lines = theoretical maxima; points = individual empirical values for 50 randomly sampled days"
  ) +
theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    axis.text        = element_text(color = "black")
  )
```

### Weekly biomass change by patch


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}

      summarise(prop_warm = mean(patch == "warm"), .groups = "drop") |>
      group_by(cal_week) |>
      summarise(mean_prop_warm = mean(prop_warm), .groups = "drop") |>
      mutate(ptype = s$ptype)
  }
) |>
  mutate(ptype     = factor(ptype,   levels = ptype_levels),
         week_date = as.Date(paste0(ref_year, "-01-01")) + (cal_week - 1L) * 7L)

# ── Stacked biomass + occupancy overlay ───────────────────────────────────────
# facet_grid(species ~ ptype, scales = "free_y") + sec_axis conflicts because
# sec_axis uses a single global transformation. One plot per species (combined
# with patchwork) gives each its own correctly scaled secondary axis.
make_week_occ_plot <- function() {
  wd    <- week_abs 
  od    <- occ_week 
  g_max <- max(wd$mean_biom, na.rm = TRUE)

  ggplot(wd, aes(x = week_date, y = mean_biom, fill = patch_label)) +
    geom_col(position = "stack", width = 7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_line(data = od,
              aes(x = week_date, y = mean_prop_warm * g_max),
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = patch_cols, name = "Patch") +
    scale_x_date(
      breaks = seq(as.Date(paste0(ref_year, "-01-01")),
                   as.Date(paste0(ref_year, "-12-01")), by = "month"),
      labels = \(x) substr(format(x, "%b"), 1, 1),
      expand = expansion(0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels   = scales::label_comma(),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / g_max,
                          name   = "Prop. adults in warm patch",
                          labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1))
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ptype, nrow = 1) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y.right = element_blank(),
          legend.position    = "right",
          axis.text          = element_text(color = "black"))
}

# Shared y-axis titles: strip the titles from both plots, then flank the

y_right <- wrap_elements(

)

inner <- (make_week_occ_plot()) +
```

### Mean annual warm habitat contribution


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Sum seasonal totals to annual, then apply the WarmContribution.qmd approach:
# positive warm / (positive warm + positive cold), averaged over years.
warm_share <- patch_seasonal_mech |>
  group_by(ptype, year, patch) |>
  summarise(total_g = sum(total_g, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = patch, values_from = total_g, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(
    pos_warm   = pmax(warm, 0),
    pos_cold   = pmax(cold, 0),
    f_warm_pos = if_else(pos_warm + pos_cold > 0,
                         pos_warm / (pos_warm + pos_cold),
                         NA_real_)
  ) |>
  group_by(ptype) |>
  summarise(
    mean_f_warm = mean(f_warm_pos, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_f_warm   = sd(f_warm_pos,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups     = "drop"
  )

ggplot(warm_share, aes(x = ptype, y = mean_f_warm, fill = ptype)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = pmax(0, mean_f_warm - sd_f_warm),
        ymax = pmin(1, mean_f_warm + sd_f_warm)),
    width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ptype_greens, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0, 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    x        = "Consumption type",
    y        = "Mean proportion of annual biomass\naccrued in warm patch",
    title    = "Annual biomass accrued in warm patch by consumption type",
    subtitle = "Cold + Warm scenarios only  |  Positive growth only  |  Error bars = \u00b11 SD across years"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    axis.text          = element_text(color = "black")
  )
```

```{.r .cell-code}
# Re-process raw IBM data to get mean daily ggd per fish, by patch and season
season_percap <- purrr::map_dfr(
  ibm_list_mech[sapply(ibm_list_mech, \(s) s$ht == "Cold + Warm")],
  function(s) {
    s$df |>
      filter(date >= exp_start_date, !is.na(ggd), floor(age) >= 1) |>
      mutate(
        year   = year(date),
        season = factor(case_when(
          month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2)  ~ "Winter",
          month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5)   ~ "Spring",
          month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8)   ~ "Summer",
          month(date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
        ), levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall"))
      ) |>
      mutate(daily_growth_g = weight * ggd) |>
      group_by(year, season, patch) |>
      summarise(
        total_g    = sum(daily_growth_g, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_fish_days = n(),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      mutate(mean_daily_g = total_g / n_fish_days,
             ptype = s$ptype)
  }
) |>
  mutate(ptype   = factor(ptype,   levels = ptype_levels)) |>
  group_by(ptype, season, patch) |>
  summarise(
    mean_percap = mean(mean_daily_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_percap   = sd(mean_daily_g,   na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_totalg = mean(total_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_totalg   = sd(total_g,   na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_fishdays = mean(n_fish_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_fishdays   = sd(n_fish_days,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(patch_label = factor(
    if_else(patch == "cold", "Cold patch", "Warm patch"),
    levels = c("Cold patch", "Warm patch")
  ))

ggplot(season_percap, aes(x = season, y = mean_percap, fill = ptype)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_percap - sd_percap,
        ymax = mean_percap + sd_percap),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ptype_greens, name = "Consumption type") +
  facet_grid(species ~ patch_label, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x        = "Season",
    y        = "Mean daily biomass change per fish (g/fish/day)",
    title    = "Per-capita seasonal biomass change by patch and consumption type",
    subtitle = "Cold + Warm scenarios only  |  Mean of annual (total patch growth / fish-days)  |  Error bars = \u00b11 SD across years"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    legend.position    = "right",
    axis.text          = element_text(color = "black")
  )


ggplot(season_percap, aes(x = season, y = mean_fishdays, fill = ptype)) +
```
